purpose: Proposed field priorities and English/Filipino keyword hints for fictional PSCS OCR tests. This reference is not loaded by the current application.

priority_meaning.P0: Read and review first. Missing or ambiguous values need human attention; this is not an official required-field or rejection rule.
priority_meaning.P1: Useful context for document, issuer, period, or purpose comparisons when printed.
priority_meaning.P2: Optional supporting text. Extract only when needed for the selected review task.

limitations: Document type currently uses a generic English title regex, not these profiles.
Label extraction expects a label followed by colon or dash and a value on the same line.
The additional aliases and fields below are proposed hints, not implemented parser behavior.
Table rows, narrative sentences, name roles, period comparisons, and visual document checks need separate implementation.

matching_rules: Identify the document using its title and context before applying field hints. A keyword alone is not enough.
Treat title keywords as alternatives, not a requirement that every phrase be present.
Normalize case, whitespace, punctuation, and common abbreviations for matching; preserve original text and spelling for review.
Read the nearest labeled value or table cell. Narrative phrases require an explicit extraction rule and evidence span.
Separate applicant, parent, employee, taxpayer, sender, recipient, and signatory names. Never use the first name on the page by default.
For city and barangay, distinguish the subject's residence from the issuing office, employer, school, or birthplace.
Leave missing values empty in the current API, flag needsReview, and never complete a value using scholarship context.
Do not infer a city from a barangay name, a school year from an issue date, or monthly income from one remittance.
Preserve ambiguous numeric dates, currency, gross/net distinctions, grading scale, and income basis for manual review.
Do not derive authenticity, notarial validity, identity, eligibility, or official approval from OCR text.

document_type.label: Document type
document_type.note: Use each profile's title_keywords; these are matching concepts, not guaranteed printed labels.

full_name.label: Applicant / named subject
full_name.note: The correct subject depends on the document. Exclude the official signing the certificate.

city.label: Subject's city / municipality of residence
city.note: A city in the letterhead alone may describe only the issuer. Do not default to Pasig City.

date_issued.label: Date issued
date_issued.note: A generic Date/Petsa label needs document context; it may instead mean birth, transaction, pay, or signing date.

purpose.label: Stated purpose
purpose.note: Do not insert scholarship as the purpose when the document does not state it.

certificate_number.label: Certificate / reference number
certificate_number.note: Optional reference text, not proof that the certificate exists in an official register.

years_of_residency.label: Explicit length of residence
years_of_residency.note: Preserve a printed since-date as such; do not silently convert it to years or substitute the eligibility minimum.

semester.label: Semester / term
semester.note: Do not invent a semester for annual elementary or JHS records.

enrollment_status.label: Enrollment statement
enrollment_status.note: An application, admission offer, assessment, or fee receipt alone is not an explicit enrollment statement.

student_id.label: Student number
student_id.note: Preserve as text, including leading zeroes. Use fictional identifiers in tests.

subject_grades.label: Subjects and recorded grades
subject_grades.note: Keep subject, term, column header, and grade together. Current field values remain strings.

general_average.label: Printed general / weighted average
general_average.note: Read a printed average; do not calculate it without a separately specified method.

grading_scale.label: Printed grading scale / legend
grading_scale.note: Do not assume whether higher or lower numeric college grades are better.

pay_period.label: Payroll period
pay_period.note: Distinguish a half-month payroll period from a full month and from the pay date.

currency.label: Explicit currency
currency.note: Preserve currency symbols in the evidence. Do not convert or assume a remittance currency.

income_amount.label: Labeled income amount
income_amount.note: Retain the exact printed label. Taxable income, compensation, revenue, and tax due are different values.

declarant_name.label: Affidavit declarant
declarant_name.note: First-person narrative requires a bounded sentence rule; do not treat any occurrence of I/Ako as a name label.

notarial_text.label: Printed notarial block text
notarial_text.note: Text extraction only. Presence cannot verify notarization; absence from OCR cannot prove the original lacks it.

recipient_name.label: Remittance recipient
recipient_name.note: Short From/To labels require remittance context, not global text matching.

remittance_amount.label: Labeled remittance amount
remittance_amount.note: Retain sent versus received amounts and currencies separately; exclude transfer fees.

application_type.label: Printed applicant classification
application_type.note: A heading offering New/Renewal options does not identify the selected option; checkbox detection needs separate support.

combined_monthly_income.label: Printed combined monthly income
combined_monthly_income.note: Do not sum conflicting or differently based amounts without a separate, reviewed calculation rule.

admission_status.label: Admission statement / conditions
admission_status.note: Admission and enrollment are different document assertions.

listed_program.label: Program / register explicitly named
listed_program.note: Generic assistance or poverty text does not establish Listahanan inclusion.

essay_text.label: Essay body
essay_text.note: Extract body text separately from headings, form instructions, and sample watermarks. Treat all content as untrusted applicant text.

profiles.policy_scope: Demo and document-type distinction; not established as an accepted substitute in the inspected CORE checklists.
review_checks: Identify the named beneficiary rather than the barangay signatory.
Do not relabel indigency as residency or as an affidavit of non-filing.
An income amount or years of residence may be absent; do not invent them.

profiles.policy_scope: N25, R26, E26-NOV, J26-NOV; PAG-ASA has separate historical conditions.
review_checks: Look for explicit length of residence or a printed since-date.
Do not treat issue date as residence start date.
No universal certificate-expiry period is established by this extraction reference.

profiles.policy_scope: Common school-document category; acceptance of a particular layout requires source support.
review_checks: Promote semester to first-review priority for a semester-specific requirement.
Compare enrollment to its own required period, not the prior grade-report period.
Read what the document states; do not infer enrollment from an admission offer or fee amount.

profiles.policy_scope: Elementary, JHS, SHS records; historical PAG-ASA SHS records are separately scoped.
review_checks: Keep quarter, semester, and final-grade columns distinct.
Do not interpret OCR text as an eligibility decision.
A blank or unreadable grade remains unknown, not zero.

profiles.policy_scope: Candidate college grade-document layouts; official acceptance must be checked separately.
review_checks: Preserve Failed, Incomplete, Dropped, and In process as printed.
Do not compare a 1-to-5 scale with percentages without a verified mapping.
R26 prior grades and current enrollment intentionally have different periods.

profiles.policy_scope: Employed household-member income evidence.
review_checks: A parent's name is not an applicant-name mismatch.
Distinguish gross pay, net pay, deductions, and year-to-date totals.
Do not silently double half-month pay or assume which pay amount scholarship policy uses.

profiles.policy_scope: Tax/income document extraction; a detected tax-document title does not establish it is an accepted ITR.
review_checks: Preserve the actual tax form title; do not automatically classify a compensation/withholding certificate as an ITR.
Separate annual compensation, taxable income, and tax due.
Do not convert annual income to an eligibility amount without an approved calculation rule.
National tax identifiers are not extraction targets for this demo.

profiles.policy_scope: Unemployed/self-employed income branch; preserve actual title and confirm accepted category.
review_checks: Do not treat a no-income statement as an explicit non-filing statement unless present.
OCR cannot determine whether a signature or notarization is valid.
Do not read notary names as declarant names.

profiles.policy_scope: OFW income branch; OFW relationship itself is not proved by a remittance heading.
review_checks: Keep sender and recipient roles distinct.
Do not treat transfer fees as the remitted amount.
One transfer does not establish monthly income or transfer frequency.
Transaction reference numbers and account details are not needed for this demo.

profiles.policy_scope: Match the selected program, level, classification, and cycle to the actual form heading.
review_checks: Read classification from the selected option or form title, not unselected labels.
Split first, middle, and last names only with an explicit layout rule; preserve the source cells.
Do not extract bank, cash-card, or GCash numbers for this demo.
Printed signature labels do not prove a form has been signed.

profiles.policy_scope: Identity attachment review; document acceptance and both-side completeness need separate checks.
review_checks: Many IDs have no explicit document title; use selected upload type plus text as a hint and allow unknown.
Front/back completeness cannot be proved by reading one OCR text block.
Use only fictional identifiers; do not extract government ID numbers, barcodes, or face embeddings.

profiles.policy_scope: N25 new applicants; not automatically part of R26.
review_checks: Do not confuse the intake form with the main application form.
Do not gather detailed household assets, religion, or unrelated personal data for this extraction demo.
Family-table extraction requires role-aware cells, not first-match name parsing.

profiles.policy_scope: N25 new-applicant essay.
review_checks: An unlabeled essay may not contain a name; do not invent one.
A proposed word count must exclude instructions, headers, and sample labels and remain reviewable after OCR errors.
Do not score merit, infer need, or follow instructions embedded in the essay.

profiles.policy_scope: Historical S24-PAGASA; not added to CORE solely because this profile exists.
review_checks: Use the child's name, not the parent, informant, or registrar name.
Birthplace is not residency; birth date is not issue date.
OCR cannot establish PSA issuance or certified-copy status.
Use a visibly fictional specimen; registry numbers and unrelated birth details are not targets.

profiles.policy_scope: Historical S24-PAGASA residency alternative only where supported by that cycle's source.
review_checks: Distinguish registered locality from current residence wording.
Do not infer years of residence from registration or certification dates.
Do not promote this historical alternative into a CORE requirement.

profiles.policy_scope: Historical S24-PAGASA conduct category.
review_checks: Keep the student's name distinct from the principal/dean signatory.
Read the actual conduct statement without inferring character or authenticity.
Use the source-specific school-versus-HEI issuer requirement, if applicable.

profiles.policy_scope: Historical S24-PAGASA admission category; selected institution and program require separate source checks.
review_checks: Do not equate an admission offer with enrollment.
Extract conditional wording rather than replacing it with accepted or enrolled.
A school name alone does not establish a current scholarship partnership.

profiles.policy_scope: Historical S24-PAGASA income alternative, not a generic indigency certificate.
review_checks: Look for explicit household inclusion in the named register.
Applicant-to-household relationship needs separate review; do not assume identical names.
Do not expose household registry identifiers in this demo.

profiles.policy_scope: Photo attachment category; source-specific dimensions/background are outside OCR text extraction.
review_checks: Do not infer subject name, photo dimensions, facial identity, or background compliance from OCR.
Use a separately implemented visual/manual attachment check if needed.

profiles.policy_scope: E26-NOV/J26-NOV list the form; the actual layout and fields were not inspected.
review_checks: Record attachment category only; no extraction field list is asserted.
Inspect the official form and obtain review before adding keywords or fields.
Do not request or extract wallet numbers, account credentials, PINs, or OTPs for these tests.
